sources.title: Copy of Fine-Tune XLS-R on Common Voice.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: In this notebook, we will give an in-detail explanation of how XLS-R - more specifically the pre-trained checkpoint Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M - can be fine-tuned for ASR. For demonstration purposes, we fine-tune the model on the low resource ASR dataset of Common Voice that contains only ca. 4h of validated training data.
